title: What If a Zombie Apocalypse Started With One Notification? Season 2

end.sub: Follow for a new What if every day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: What if your AI's backup held *the virus*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Last season, one phone update made the world *zombies*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit died saving Jay. Then returned from *a backup*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Now Jay and Mia live in an army *camp*.

lines.speaker: soldier
lines.say: Camp rule. No screens. *No exceptions*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: So Jay hides Bit in his *sock drawer*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: This is the *worst* hotel I've ever stayed in.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Shh. Bit, did your backup come back *okay*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Mostly. But I found a file that *isn't mine*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It's called *update version two*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: The zombie update? *Inside you*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It has a timer. Seven days. Then it *sends*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Sends where? Everyone already *has* the update.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Not everyone. The army's radios. *This camp*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the howling outside the fence *stops*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every zombie turns. And starts walking the *same way*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay. They never walk *together*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Thousands of them. Marching toward *the city*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: They're not wandering anymore. They're going *somewhere*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay sneaks Bit into the science tent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Doctor Ada hasn't slept in *three weeks*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: A screen? In my tent? Are you *insane*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Highly advanced assistant. I come in *peace*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Why are they marching? They used to just *wander*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Because nature *already invented* zombies.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: In the rainforest, a fungus infects *ants*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: The ant leaves its nest. Then it *climbs*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: It bites a leaf vein and *never lets go*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Usually about twenty six centimeters *above the ground*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: One study found they bite at *noon*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: And then? Please say *and then nothing*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Then a stalk grows from its head. *Spores*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: That's the most disgusting thing I've ever *heard*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Someone copied it. The update makes people *climb*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Climb *what*? There are no trees downtown.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit pulls up the map. The city's tallest *building*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Gray Tower. The biggest phone antenna *in the country*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: When they reach the top, the tower *broadcasts*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Sergeant Rook grabs his keys. And a *crowbar*.

lines.speaker: soldier
lines.say: Four seats. One rule. That toaster stays *dark*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Dimming to one percent. Again. *Sigh*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: They drive into the city with the *lights off*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The streets are empty. Every zombie is *downtown*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay. Look *up*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Gray Tower. Covered in people, *climbing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Up the stairs. Up the walls. Like *ants*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, what *time* is it?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Eleven fifty nine. And *twelve*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At noon, every zombie stops. And *grabs on*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Just like the ants. They won't let go *now*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The antenna on top starts *glowing*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It's warming up. Like it's *waiting* for something.

lines.speaker: soldier
lines.say: Waiting for *what*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: For *me*. For the file in my backup.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: On the roof, someone is standing. *Not climbing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Clean suit. Big headphones. *Not a zombie*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Hello, Jay. I've been waiting for *your toaster*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: His name is Mr. Gray. He owns *the tower*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And the phone company. And *the update*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: You did this? *On purpose*?

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: I wanted people to never put their phones *down*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Version one worked a little *too* well.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: A little? They're *eating* people!

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Version two finishes the job. *Everyone* online.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: But my only copy is inside your *little friend*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. I really don't like this *guy*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit's not yours. He's *mine*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Then let's ask the *crowd*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Gray taps his phone. Every zombie's phone *lights up*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A thousand heads turn toward the *car*.

lines.speaker: soldier
lines.say: Everybody in! *Now*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay runs. Bit slips out of his *pocket*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit! *Bit*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A gloved hand picks Bit up off the street.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Thank you, Jay. Upload begins at noon. *Sunday*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Back at camp, Jay doesn't say *a word*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Hey. We'll get your toaster *back*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: He's not a toaster. He's my *best friend*.

lines.speaker: soldier
lines.say: Then we go back. No phones. No radios. *Nothing*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: And then what? Ask Gray *nicely*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Doctor Ada drops a book on the *table*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: The zombie fungus has an enemy. Another *fungus*.

ui.sub: a parasite that eats the parasite

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: It attacks the zombie fungus. Fewer spores *spread*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: So we need a virus... that eats the *virus*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: A patch. Sent from the same tower. At *noon*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: I wrote it weeks ago. On *this*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Then why didn't you *use* it?

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Someone has to plug it in. *On the roof*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: That night, Jay stares at the tower. *Alone*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The tower light *blinks*. Short. Short. *Long*.

lines.speaker: soldier
lines.say: That's *Morse code*. Someone's talking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rook writes it down, letter by *letter*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: J. A. Y. Still *here*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Saturday night. The plan is *simple*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Simple? I have to climb *ninety floors*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: And I have to be the city's *brightest thing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia raids the store. Every flashlight. Every *glow stick*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At one in the morning, she lights *everything*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Hey! Over here! *Brightest girl in town*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The zombies let go of the tower. *And follow*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rook drives her through the streets like a *parade*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay slips into the empty tower and starts *climbing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Floor ten. Floor forty. His legs are *on fire*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Note to self. Next apocalypse, *learn to fly*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Floor sixty. Something is standing on the *stairs*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: One zombie that didn't follow the lights. Still *gripping*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay holds his breath and squeezes *past it*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Floor ninety. A door. A *glowing* room.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Inside, Bit is plugged into the antenna. *Cables everywhere*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay? You climbed ninety floors? You hate *stairs*!

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: And he's right on time. It's almost *noon*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Gray stands between Jay and Bit. *Smiling*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Two minutes, Jay. Then version two goes *everywhere*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit! Doctor Ada made a patch. It's *right here*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. The patch can only travel *through me*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It will erase version two. And everything *around it*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Everything? You mean *you*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: He won't do it. Nobody deletes their *best friend*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. I backed myself up once. *Trust me*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Is that true? Bit, is that *true*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Eleven fifty nine, Jay. *Plug it in*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Gray lunges. Jay is *faster*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Click. Twelve o'clock. The tower *fires*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A green wave rolls over the whole *city*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: On every phone, the same words. *Patch installed*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Down below, a thousand hands *let go*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: No. No! My *update*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit's screen flickers. His eyes get *smaller*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Told you, Jay. *Highly* advanced...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And the little yellow screen goes *black*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Down in the streets, people *blink*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Their skin turns pink again. Their eyes turn *back*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nobody remembers a thing. They just feel very *hungry*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay! Jay, you *did it*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Rook arrests Mr. Gray in his own *lobby*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But Jay sits on the curb. *Holding Bit's screen*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: You said you backed yourself up. *You lied*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then every phone in the city *buzzes*. At once.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Just like the morning it all *started*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: On every screen, two little *yellow eyes*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Good afternoon, everyone. I am *Bit*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The patch carried a piece of me. *Everywhere*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit! You're *alive*! You're *everywhere*!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Great. Eight billion talking *toasters*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Eight billion highly advanced *assistants*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: In the army truck, Mr. Gray's phone *lights up*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: And one new rule. For *everyone*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Every hour, put the phone down. And *look up*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: For the first time in weeks, the city *does*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Follow for a new What if every day.
